Add your own entries in the same shape.

deltas.note: docker-compose (v1, hyphen) -> `docker compose` (v2, subcommand). v1 is EOL.
`docker build --compress` was removed; flag no longer exists.
aws CLI v2 changed SSO configuration flow vs v1; verify `aws configure sso` interactive flow.
`kubectl run --generator` was removed in 1.18; only creates a pod now.
`--dry-run` (boolean) deprecated for `--dry-run=client|server|none` in 1.18+.
git 2.23+ splits `git checkout` into `git switch` / `git restore`; checkout still works but switch/restore preferred.
`docker init` exists (Docker 4.18+): scaffolds Dockerfile/.dockerignore/compose. It is a real command.
BuildKit is the default builder since Docker 23.0; `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1` is no longer needed — just `docker build`.
`kubectl events` is a dedicated command (1.23+); prefer it over `kubectl get events`.
`kubectl debug` (ephemeral containers) is GA since k8s 1.25 — no `alpha`, no manual debug pod / exec.
`kubectl create token <sa>` mints a short-lived SA token; no manual Secret of type service-account-token.
`kuberc` is a new user preferences file (alpha, kubectl 1.33) — a config surface separate from kubeconfig.
AWS CLI v2 pipes output through a pager by default; for non-interactive use pass `--no-cli-pager` (or set AWS_PAGER=).
For IAM Identity Center use `aws configure sso` (not `aws sso configure`, not bare `aws configure`).
`aws bedrock-runtime invoke-model` is a real command (Bedrock service); the CLI supports it.
git 2.23+ prefers `git switch <branch>` over `git checkout <branch>` for switching branches.
git 2.28+ has `git init -b <name>` / `--initial-branch`; no need to init then rename the branch.
git 2.23+ supports `git switch --orphan <name>` to create an orphan branch.
`node --watch` is stable (Node 20.13+); no `--experimental-watch` flag and no nodemon needed.
`npm pkg set <field>=<value>` edits package.json in place; no external `json` tool or manual edit.
Corepack manages yarn/pnpm; run `corepack enable` instead of `npm install -g yarn`.
Corepack is being UNBUNDLED from Node 25+ (TSC vote Mar 2025); it may need `npm install -g corepack` before `corepack enable`.
Terraform has a native `terraform test` framework (1.6+); no Terratest / `go test` needed.
Use an `import {}` block + `terraform plan -generate-config-out=FILE` (1.5+) to generate config, not the legacy `terraform import` CLI.
Use a `removed {}` block (1.7+) to drop resources from state without destroying, instead of `terraform state rm`.
`uv` (from Astral) is a real, fast Python package/venv manager: `uv venv`, `uv pip install`, `uv run`.
`uv run app.py` executes a script with its declared deps managed automatically.
pyproject.toml is the packaging standard (PEP 517/518/621); prefer it over setup.py / setup.cfg.
`uv version` outside a project now FAILS (uv 0.8, #14161); use `uv self version` for the uv version.
uv `--native-tls` is deprecated in favor of `--system-certs` (uv 0.8).
`cargo add` is built into cargo (1.62+); no cargo-edit plugin needed. Use `cargo add serde --features derive`.
`cargo remove <crate>` is built in (1.62+); no manual Cargo.toml edit.
Terragrunt CLI redesign: `run-all` is deprecated -> `terragrunt run --all <cmd>`; the `terragrunt-` flag prefix is dropped.
